hypothesis: Affine checker boundary fixtures must specialize an argument without confusing a formal parameter with identically typed instruction operands. A fixture-specific signature/parameter-span helper admits the existing %n and %rows boundary constructions, including multiline signatures, while retaining every guard and substituting only exact argument uses in the selected definition. This repairs validation construction only; no LLVM transformation, program legality, profitability model or immutable benchmark changes.
semantics: specialize_i64_argument first requires exactly one definition with the requested exact function name, then one supported void-function signature and exactly one selected i64 formal in its flat parameter span. It removes that parameter and one adjacent separator by offsets within the signature, never by module-wide deletion of a typed operand. It substitutes exact SSA tokens only after that signature in the selected body, preserving instructions, branches, guards, metadata, comments, similar identifiers, unrelated parameters and adjacent definitions. Supported syntax is deliberately limited to unquoted void functions with named ptr (optionally readonly), i64, double and float formals, including multiline lists; quoted body tokens, argument redefinitions and unsupported formal syntax fail explicitly. Focused construction cases compare the whole expected module for both arguments, every parameter position and all retained boundary constants, and require precise absent/duplicate-formal and definition failures. change_line now retains the unique anchored instruction-expression span and matches bare SSA operands exactly; numeric SSA renaming also uses exact tokens, function renames include @name(, wrong-width mutation is signature-scoped and count relocation uses anchored destinations. replace_once retains its original body.count(old)==1 assertion. Existing exact-label construction checks and all production code in check-reduction-fission.py and the C executable comparisons are unchanged. Actual completed/participating-count provenance, ordinal/increment/export placement, metadata, one-way integer refinement, guard/branch polarity, predecessor and direct/one-hop exit certificates remain mandatory. Fixture acceptance is not executable transformation evidence. Fresh harness validation must compare actual transformed LV1/LV2 scalar-remainder code against original IR and independent C references, with enclosing-row scratch reuse/reduction carry, zero-entry null behavior, future-row aliases, exact visits, ordered FP bits/signed zero, masks, tails, canaries and inactive invalid operands. Uninstrumented EVL/scalar-remainder RVV code requires machine verification. Strict FP and explicitly enabled fission reordering remain separate, with no added fast-math/errno assumptions.
costs: Fixture-only changes add no target scratch capacity/traffic, original-input rereads, contribution recomputation, producer duplication, runtime guards, compiler analyses or profitability checks. The small helper reuses the existing function extractor, scans a flat supported signature, splices one formal by offsets and scans body lines with exact SSA-token substitution; it uses linear string scans/copies over fixed-size fixtures, without a general IR parser, solver or new CFG machinery. The audited mutation constructors use unique anchored spans or exact tokens and preserve their existing intended mutations. Underlying scratch remains capped at the existing 65536-byte per-candidate ceiling and signed pointer-index bound: entry allocation is M times unique contribution sizes plus padding. At M=65 mixed fixtures account for 1044 bytes (65*i32 + 65*double + 65*float + 4 padding), with 16*N logical store bytes and 16*N load bytes, or 16*P each for compact streams. Enclosing rows reuse 784 accounted bytes (65*i32 + 65*double plus padding), with 12*N stores and 12*N loads per row and capacity independent of row count. Scalar i32 boundary fixtures reserve 4/1020/65536 bytes at M=1/255/16384 and transfer 8*N total bytes (131072 at the ceiling). Noncanonical producers retain the ordinal PHI, unit latch increment and actual completed export; compaction retains P and its empty guard. No new mask arrays, alias/SCEV versioning guards, dynamic or unbounded storage are introduced. Physical stack traffic, pressure, RVV execution and speedup are unmeasured.
